description: This file defines a class 'Location' extending 'FilterField' and implementing 'ValueXNormalizable'. It handles filtering and retrieving information about locations within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for report filtering purposes. The class includes methods to modify query builders based on location IDs, extract location IDs, and convert location data to array format.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Represents a filter field for location entities in report generation, enabling filtering by location IDs and providing location details.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Modifies the query builder to filter results based on location IDs, supporting special case for country-based selection.

methods.name: getLocationIds
methods.description: Returns an array of location IDs parsed from the 'X' parameter.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns aliases for the entity involved in the filter, in this case, 'location'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the first location ID into a detailed array with 'id' and 'label' if the location exists.
